ops.text: (d) Contractor shall defend and indemnify Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses, to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any data breach or unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company's Confidential Information caused by Contractor; or (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Company shall give Contractor prompt written notice of any such claim and reasonable cooperation in the defense, and Contractor shall have control of the defense. Contractor's obligations under this Section 7(d) are not subject to the limitations set forth in Sections 7(a), 7(b) and 7(c).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 promises indemnification but contains no operative indemnity in either direction, leaving us exposed to third-party IP and misconduct claims. We have inserted the preferred Contractor defence and indemnity as new 7(d), with only notice, control and cooperation mechanics and a carve-out from the Section 7 limitations; a 3x annual fees super-cap on these obligations is available as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert a Contractor defence and indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, Contractor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) as new Section 7(d) with notice, control and cooperation mechanics.
